justification: Changes how two loaders store spatial_overlays shapes: broken or >50k-point shapes become valid <=1000-point pieces. Standard: affects stored geometry on the next re-run, not served logic.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if a broken shape is stored unsplit, a piece exceeds 1,000 points, area changes, a mid-size valid shape is split, or keys differ between runs.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Live DB 2026-10-29: the helper reproduces the stored piece counts for three repaired rows (Shoalhaven 1, Bellingen 3, Cumberland 48).
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before: both loaders upsert by original feature number, so a re-run re-inserts the 269 repaired originals (one with 2.27M points) beside their pieces.

pre_impl.existing_data: spatial_overlays unique (instrument_key, layer_type, source_oid); 13,455 repaired pieces keyed 10^12+oid*1e5+n.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Loaders assumed source shapes are valid and small.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New shared helper; no new data source.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A row with no feature number is stored unchanged.

functions.name: explode_rows
functions.what: Split broken or huge shapes into valid pieces with stable keys.
functions.input: loader row tuples with feature number and WKT shape
functions.output: the same rows, with broken or huge shapes replaced by piece rows
functions.if_none: a row with no feature number is stored unchanged
functions.failure_mode: shapely error raises in the loader before any write
